name: Distro 10 - (5g) Baller Bucket - Lemon Cherry Gelato
description:
Fresh-frozen flavor, bulk size. The Distro 10 Lemon Cherry Gelato Baller Bucket packs a full 5 grams of live resin — full-spectrum concentrate extracted from fresh-frozen flower to lock in the terpenes and aroma the plant started with. Bold, flavorful, and built for people who go through it.

Lemon Cherry Gelato is a hugely popular hybrid known for its rich, layered flavor. Expect sweet cherry and bright citrus up front, rounded out by creamy, dessert-like gelato smoothness and a subtly gassy finish. Because it's live resin, every dab hits with deeper flavor and a fuller, more well-rounded effect — a balanced, easygoing calm paired with a gentle mood lift that fits just about any time of day.

Why you'll love it:

5G live resin — bulk value in one bucket, fresh-frozen extraction for maximum terpene preservation
Full-spectrum flavor — rich, aromatic, and true to the strain
Signature Lemon Cherry Gelato flavor — sweet cherry and citrus with creamy gelato smoothness
Bucket packaging — easy to scoop, easy to store, ready to dab

Big flavor, premium potency, and true-to-plant character in every gram. Distro 10 Lemon Cherry Gelato is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets. Requires a compatible dab rig or vaporizer.
